briefing-evaluation.intro_html:
Welcome to ThePaymaster®

Congratulations on reaching this exciting milestone!
You're about to take the final step in completing your deal – distributing the agreed payments smoothly and securely.


Before You Begin...

Please confirm that your transaction meets the following criteria:

  • The total transaction value is £250,000 or more (exceptions for monthly recurring deals)
  • Your deal is either completed or in its final stages and funds have been verified
  • Before our call we need to know the full name and email of everyone that will be on the call - no exceptions!
  • All parties involved are prepared to complete our verification process


If you're not quite there yet, don't worry!

Bookmark this page and return when you're ready. We're excited to work with you, but starting too early might cause unnecessary delays.

Ready to proceed? Great! Please complete the form below.
